headline: Indiabulls Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'acquisition of  70% of the issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital of Fintech Cloud Private Limited  and execution of definitive agreement , in this regard'.
